deep_dive.title: Self-Supervised Topologically Invariant Manifold Learning for Railway Image Quality Assessment
deep_dive.abstract: Existing blind image quality assessment (BIQA) methods typically rely on synthetic distortions and subjective annotations, limiting generalization in real-world domains. To address this, we propose a fully self-supervised BIQA framework based on topologically invariant manifold learning under boundary constraints, which constructs a stable quality reference without manual labels. The framework generates progressive background dilution scales via repeated random cropping around each target; exploiting the monotonic degradation of target information density across these scales, it establishes a self-constrained quality manifold. A linearized spatial moment projection eliminates geometric distortions from random cropping; then a monotonicity divergence filter prunes background-sensitive evaluators, isolating an elite pool \(\mathcal{M}_{\text{elite}}\). A robust M-estimator with a principal component stabilizer fuses the metrics into an asymptotically efficient pseudo-ground truth \(q_{\text{PGT}}\), contracting variance toward the Cramér-Rao lower bound. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the elite evaluator pool, distilled from 11 baseline metrics, secures superior zero-shot transferability across standard synthetic and wild benchmarks (CSIQ, LIVEC, LIVE-2). Concurrently, deployments on the CQU Railway Rolling Stock Surveillance Dataset (2,797 images) yield a manifold cosine similarity \(>0.999\) and a 100.0\% survival rate under industrial extreme stresses, robustly validating its cross-paradigm decoupling and topological resilience.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: The paper presents a fully self-supervised BIQA framework using topologically invariant manifold learning, eliminating the need for subjective annotations and synthetic distortions; it builds a self-constrained quality manifold from progressive background dilution scales and achieves stable quality prediction.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对现有盲图像质量评估方法依赖合成失真和主观标注、难以泛化到真实场景的问题，本文提出一种基于拓扑不变流形学习的完全自监督评估框架。该方法通过目标周围重复随机裁剪生成渐进背景稀释尺度，利用目标信息密度单调退化建立自约束质量流形，并结合线性化空间矩投影消除几何畸变。实验表明该框架无需人工标签即可为铁路图像提供稳定质量参考，显著提升了真实域泛化能力。
